text: Hi, we were charged twice for our annual TaskHarbor Business plan this month. Invoice numbers INV-20931 and INV-20932. Can you refund the duplicate?
I can't log in. Reset my password three times and the reset email never arrives. I have a client deadline today and all my tasks are in there.
Since this morning the Kanban board throws 'Something went wrong (500)' whenever anyone on our team drags a card between columns. Whole engineering org (40 people) can't update work.
Would love the ability to set recurring subtasks that reset every sprint. Right now we copy them by hand.
Our chat-app integration stopped posting task updates to our channels on Tuesday. Reconnecting it says 'token expired' and then loops back to the same screen.

One of our devs accidentally pasted our TaskHarbor API token into a public code repo about an hour ago. We deleted the commit but I'm not sure if it was scraped. How do we rotate it and check what was accessed?
I got a 'new sign-in from an unrecognized device' email from TaskHarbor at 3am from a country I've never been to. Then my 2FA was turned off. I didn't do that.
We downgraded from Business to Team last week but we're still being billed for 25 seats instead of 10. Also, unrelated, the CSV export is cutting off descriptions at 255 characters.
A contractor whose access we removed last month can still see our private 'Acquisitions' project in their sidebar. They just sent us a screenshot. This is a big deal for us.
Does TaskHarbor have an office in Lisbon? Our procurement team wants to know for vendor paperwork.
SSO via our identity provider is failing for everyone in our company since your release last night. Error: 'SAML response signature invalid'. 300 people locked out.
Gantt view dates are off by one day for users in UTC+13. Task due on the 5th shows on the 4th. Minor, but confusing for our NZ team.
It would be great if the API's /tasks endpoint supported filtering by custom field. Right now we pull everything and filter client-side which is slow.
ugh. nothing works. fix it.
Our card on file expired and now the workspace is in read-only mode. I updated the card but it still says read-only and nobody on the team can create tasks.
Webhook deliveries to our endpoint are arriving 20-30 minutes late since Friday. Our automations depend on them. Status page says all green.
When I open a shared project link in an incognito window it shows task titles and attachments without asking me to log in. Is that expected? The link was only shared internally.
Can you add a dark mode? Also the mobile app logs me out every time I switch apps, which is really annoying.
I'm the new admin after our previous admin left the company. Her account is the only owner and we can't change billing or add users. How do we transfer ownership?
Importing our 12,000-row spreadsheet from our old tool fails at row 8,431 with 'unexpected token'. We're mid-migration and the team is waiting on this to start using TaskHarbor.
